description: Sends the AnimatedWebs team a request for a new template or component that the catalog does not have, and returns the request id. Use it only after search_catalog found nothing suitable; use manage_request to check, list or cancel requests already sent instead of sending one again. It writes one message to the team's inbox tied to the signed-in account; every call creates a new request, so repeating it makes a duplicate. Requests are reviewed for the weekly template drops and Lifetime members are prioritized. Example: {"request":"a scroll-driven hero for a yacht charter in Miami with a night-sea video"}.

request.description: What you want built, 10 to 1500 characters: subject, industry, style, references. Example: 'a scroll-driven hero for a yacht charter in Miami with a night-sea video'.

name: request_template

id.description: Request id for manage_request; null if the inbox did not return one

title: Request an AnimatedWebs template
